This post introduces Dynamic Context Parallelism (Dynamic-CP), a scheduling approach in NVIDIA Megatron Core used for LLM post-training or DiT pre-training. It dynamically selects the CP size per microbatch to efficiently handle variable-length sequences, achieving up to 1.48x speedup on real-world datasets.
